action_replace_sender.description: Sender address used for replacement notifications (e.g., spam rejections).

action_replace_subject_prefix.description: Prefix added to subject line when message is tagged as spam.

action_replace_recipients.description: Recipient address used for replacement notifications.

log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use (e.g., mail, local0). Enum: daemon, mail, news, security, syslog, user, local4.

max_message_size.description: Maximum message size in KB for SpamAssassin scanning (0 = unlimited/unchecked).
